value.rationale: A standard natural invariant, element-centralizer rank in an exterior algebra, undergoes its first nontrivial intermediate-rank split on five generators. The exact four-rank finite-field census and irreducible singular Grassmannian degeneracy locus quantify this structural boundary; they are not the single-generator normal-element orbit result or the known four-generator commutator image census. This is a narrow but complete classification with explicit counting and intrinsic geometric motivation.
